name: light_pillar
description: a pillar of light: the set's hair burning hot round one frame point and streaming upright as translucent straight streaks, over ripple rings (a thin rim on every escape step's level line), violet on a black-indigo ground
reuses: the smooth count cut at period 1 (one rim a ring)
notes: From wallhaven-dp5p9o (item 092, triage group 13, light lines), with wallhaven-ym8rqk (glow_tube) and wallhaven-j3ygpw (string_lines) as palette entries. The look: a violet pillar of straight streaks standing on ripple rings in the dark. No new engine member. **Straight lines are the post stage's `rays`** (078): one escape loop draws only arcs. The rays cast from the brightest share of the frame, so the stack makes that share gather at one point: a radial pool of light round `core` [0.5, 0.6] and the hair hot inside it (a `de` glow masked by the radial channel at power 40); what casts is the set's own hair there, so the pillar's streaks are the lace's detail swept upright. Two spokes at 90 degrees keep each streak one sample wide (a multiple of 45 never spreads); at other angles the beams spread into a soft tube, which is glow_tube's reading. The ripple rings are the smooth count cut at period 1 (one thin rim per escape step), so they are the set's own equipotentials.

Nearest mode: light_shafts (its baseline tile ends both formulation rows, in this map). What differs at draft size: light_shafts streams shafts outwards from a point through the whole lace (a mean of the light behind each sample); here every streak runs parallel, upright, from a small lit patch of the hair, and the rings carry the frame round it.
Reachable by one escape loop: yes for the rings and hair (one loop); no for the lines, which are a post pass (a select over the frame's luminance and one sweep per spoke).

Tuning (round one): at `rays` strength 3 and share 0.03 the beams flooded the frame white; at strength 1.5 without a core the whole lace cast a faint rain. The core is what makes a pillar; strength 0.25 at share 0.002 keeps it translucent, 0.5 and over saturates it to a white bar at most seats. **Tone**: the reference is dark (0.077/0.032) with a small bright pillar (p90 0.265). With the hair, halo and rings in the map's upper slots every seat missed p90 high (0.46 to 0.67); moving them to the middle slots (hair 0.45, halo 0.35, rings 0.45) and narrowing the core (power 20 to 40) brings six of twelve seats inside the band (`out/keep/092_light_lines_nebulae/tones.log`); the rest read 0.38 to 0.48, the pillar itself and a dense lace both over a tenth of the frame. Shorter beams (length 0.12) and dimmer ones (strength 0.12) did not move it further. j3ygpw's string art (straight chords at changing angles round a square spiral) is out of reach of one rays pass, whose spokes share one angle family: string_lines reads it as crossing bundles of parallel strings (four spokes at 45 degrees running the frame's length at strength 0.1, the core widened to power 10). Entries' tone against their own references: glow_tube (ym8rqk, 0.095/0.081: the pillar at 60 degrees, strength 0.8, length 0.4, where the spread beam reads as a tube) holds neither seat (p90 0.21 low at one, the white share 0.074 over at the other); string_lines (j3ygpw, 0.128/0.063) misses p90 high at both (0.64, 0.75 against 0.40): its crossed bundles cover far more of the frame than the reference's strings, and bundles cut to length 0.3 still read 0.58 and 0.68, so the entry is offered at length 1.0 with the miss recorded. A mosaic spiral's seams were considered and dropped: its lattice is log-polar, so its edges are arcs, not chords.

Explorer cost (092, round one, nothing else running): 21.7 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its formulation seat a (phoenix_625d9378, maxiter 3,000; both formulation seats sit at 3,000), the rays pass included (the frame is drawn whole), under the 5-minute bar.
